name: Shirobara Renzoku Satsujin Jiken
source:
"The white rose is a blood curse... Its petals are soaked and stained red by blood.
Someday, the bell will toll and all will be swept by ruin.
When the white rose wilts, all evil and curses must disappear... A.M."

Just one week after receiving this bizarre letter, the Hanayama family discovers a body at their mansion. You and your assistant return to get to the bottom of this case.
translation:
“白玫瑰是鲜血的诅咒……它的花瓣浸透鲜血，染成赤红。
终有一天，钟声响起，一切都将归于毁灭。
当白玫瑰凋零，所有邪恶与诅咒都必须消失……A.M.”

收到这封怪信仅仅一周后，花山家便在宅邸中发现了一具尸体。你与助手再度来到这里，决心查明案件的真相。
